threatData.title: Log Sys - Sys of Maint in War
threatData.text: LS commodities: food (sup); fuel, oil and lubricants; ammo; tpt (MT and AT); med; stores; reports; rec; mail; TC; care and maint of AT. Resp: ASC - food sup, fuel, ammo, AT; A Ord Corps - gen stores and clo, tech stores, amt, MT, ammo (stocking and conditioning), collection and back loading of sal; AMC - health, treatment and evac of wounded; EME - repair of vehs, amt and tech eqpt, rec and back loading of unsvc vehs; Army Postal Svc - mail; Remount and Vet Corps - care of animals; CMP - TC, con of stragglers, maint of discp.
